page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg9i.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs provided by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz. The instance is configured with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware.

The instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps. Because the CPU allocation is dedicated, workloads benefit from consistent processing performance without resource contention from other tenants on the host. The lack of local storage means that all storage operations must rely on external network-attached block storage, which is a key architectural tradeoff to consider for I/O-heavy applications.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.hfg9i.xlarge offers a balanced resource profile suitable for standard production workloads that require dedicated CPU execution without the overhead of specialized hardware. The 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes it appropriate for general-purpose applications, web serving, microservices, and development environments that do not demand local high-speed NVMe storage or GPU acceleration.
